welcome.title: Welcome to Hypocrates!
welcome.body: This is a full tour of every main page in the dashboard. You can stop at any time and restart it later from the help icon at the top.

dashboard.title: Main Dashboard
dashboard.body: Your daily overview: patients, appointments, revenue and staff notifications, all at a glance.

patients.title: Patients
patients.body: Manage every patient: personal details, medical history, treatments, documents and patient-portal access. Use this button to register a new patient.

appointments.title: Appointments
appointments.body: The full appointment list and the calendar, in two tabs on this page — schedule, drag-and-drop to reschedule, and view by doctor or room.

followups.title: Follow-ups
followups.body: Scheduled post-treatment check-ins — the system creates these itself based on the protocols you've set for each treatment type.

orthodontics.title: Orthodontics
orthodontics.body: Track step-by-step progress for patients in orthodontic treatment, with customizable stages and dates.

finance.title: Finance
finance.body: The financial overview, invoices and patient debts — three tabs, on one page.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.body: Track the clinic's stock and re-order requests whenever something drops below the minimum threshold.

staff.title: Staff
staff.body: Add and manage staff, track daily attendance and their commissions. Use this button to add a new member.

documents.title: Documents
documents.body: Every document uploaded by patients and staff, in one place.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.body: Automatic patient recalls and manual notifications — two tabs, on the same page.

website.title: Website
website.body: Control the public site's content: posts, testimonials, gallery, contact info and SEO — five tabs, one page.

sistemi.title: System
sistemi.body: System settings: audit logs, the exchange rate, and appearance (themes, colors, language).

konfigurimi.title: Configuration
konfigurimi.body: Integrations (AI, email, SMS), services, rooms, clinics and data import — everything configuration-related, in one place.

quickActions.title: Quick Actions
quickActions.body: This icon lets you quickly add a patient, appointment, staff member or service — from anywhere in the app.

assistant.title: AI Assistant
assistant.body: The chat button on every page — ask it about patients, appointments or clinic stats, or ask it to create something for you directly from the chat.

profile.title: Profile
profile.body: Your personal details and account settings.

goodbye.title: That's everything!
goodbye.body: We hope you enjoy Hypocrates. You can restart this tour any time from the help icon at the top, or from Profile. Taking you to the Main Dashboard now.
